sentences.en: He pissed away his inheritance on booze and loose women.
sentences.zh: 他把遗产都挥霍在酒和女人身上。

sentences.en: He sold his inheritance for a plate of lentil soup.
sentences.zh: 他用那份遗产换了一碗扁豆汤。

sentences.en: Who was the lucky one who ended up with the inheritance?
sentences.zh: 谁是那个幸运儿，最终得到了那份遗产？
